textbookText: Circle the correct alternative of the following questions.
1. Which of the following statement is true about drone bee?
ii) Drone bees are fed by queen bee.
iii) The function of drone bee is only to fertilize the queen bee. iv) Drone bee have sting glands and wax glands.
Ans:- iii) The function of drone bee is only to fertilize the queen bee.
